display.name: APM Dashboard (ClickHouse)
display.description: Migrated from OpenTelemetry demo 33bd823107b1b38eaa88dd4ef625cc16d60475d4. All queries use ClickHouse. Metrics preserve PromQL calculations through ClickHouse SQL; other signals read Collector tables.

spec.query:
SELECT '.*' AS value, 'All' AS label
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT value, value AS label FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT tags['service_namespace'] AS value FROM timeSeriesTags(demo_metrics) WHERE metric_name = 'target_info' AND match(tags['deployment_environment_name'], concat('^(?:', if(has([${deployment_environment_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${deployment_environment_name:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$'))
) WHERE value != ''
ORDER BY label

SELECT '.*' AS value, 'All' AS label
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT value, value AS label FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT tags['service_name'] AS value FROM timeSeriesTags(demo_metrics) WHERE metric_name = 'target_info' AND match(tags['service_namespace'], concat('^(?:', if(has([${service_namespace:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_namespace:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$')) AND match(tags['deployment_environment_name'], concat('^(?:', if(has([${deployment_environment_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${deployment_environment_name:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$'))
) WHERE value != ''
ORDER BY label

display.name: Duration
display.description:
HTTP & RPC endpoints aggregation on the `http.server.request.duration` & `rpc.server.duration` metrics.

See https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/http/http-metrics/#metric-httpserverrequestduration and https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/rpc/rpc-metrics/#metric-rpcserverduration

display.name: Error
display.description:
HTTP and RPC endpoints aggregation on the `http.server.request.duration` and `rpc.server.duration` metrics. 

Errors are identified by : 
* `http.response.status_code=~"5.."`
* `rpc.grpc.status_code!="0"`

See https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/http/http-metrics/#metric-httpserverrequestduration

spec.query:
WITH if(has([${deployment_environment_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${deployment_environment_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_deployment_environment_name,
if(has([${service_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service_name,
if(has([${service_namespace:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_namespace:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service_namespace
SELECT sample.1 AS time, if(isFinite(sample.2), sample.2, NULL) AS "HTTP 5xx",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQueryRange(demo_metrics, concat('(
    (sum by(deployment_environment_name, service_namespace, service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_deployment_environment_name), ', service_namespace=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_namespace), ', service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), ', http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), '])) * 100) 
    / 
    sum by(deployment_environment_name, service_namespace, service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_deployment_environment_name), ', service_namespace=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_namespace), ', service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), ']))
)
or
(
    0
    * 
    sum by(deployment_environment_name, service_namespace, service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_deployment_environment_name), ', service_namespace=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_namespace), ', service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), ']))
)'), toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'), toIntervalSecond({step}))
ARRAY JOIN samples AS sample
ORDER BY time

WITH if(has([${deployment_environment_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${deployment_environment_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_deployment_environment_name,
if(has([${service_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service_name,
if(has([${service_namespace:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_namespace:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service_namespace
SELECT sample.1 AS time, if(isFinite(sample.2), sample.2, NULL) AS "RPC Err",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQueryRange(demo_metrics, concat('((sum without (rpc_grpc_status_code, instance) (rate(rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_deployment_environment_name), ', service_namespace=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_namespace), ', service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), ', rpc_grpc_status_code!="0"}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), '])) * 100) / sum without (rpc_grpc_status_code, instance) (rate(rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_deployment_environment_name), ', service_namespace=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_namespace), ', service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), '])))
or
(0 * sum without (rpc_grpc_status_code, instance) (rate(rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_deployment_environment_name), ', service_namespace=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_namespace), ', service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), '])))'), toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'), toIntervalSecond({step}))
ARRAY JOIN samples AS sample
ORDER BY time

spec.query:

WITH if(has([${deployment_environment_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${deployment_environment_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_deployment_environment_name,

display.name: HTTP Operations
display.description:
Inbound HTTP operations of the service (aka HTTP endpoints) based on the `http.server.request.duration` metric.

Errors are identified by `http.response.status_code=~"5.."`.

See https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/http/http-metrics/#metric-httpserverrequestduration

spec.query:
WITH if(has([${deployment_environment_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${deployment_environment_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_deployment_environment_name,
if(has([${service_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service_name,
if(has([${service_namespace:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_namespace:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service_namespace
SELECT timestamp AS time, if(isFinite(value), value, NULL) AS "RPS",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQuery(demo_metrics, concat('sum by (operation) (
            label_join(
                rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_deployment_environment_name), ', service_namespace=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_namespace), ', service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), ']),
                "operation",
                " ",
                "http_request_method",
                "http_route"
            )
        )'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'))

WITH if(has([${deployment_environment_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${deployment_environment_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_deployment_environment_name,
if(has([${service_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service_name,
if(has([${service_namespace:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_namespace:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service_namespace
SELECT timestamp AS time, if(isFinite(value), value, NULL) AS "ERR_PCT",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQuery(demo_metrics, concat('(
        sum by (operation) (
            label_join(
                rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_deployment_environment_name), ', service_namespace=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_namespace), ', service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), ', http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), ']),
                "operation",
                " ",
                "http_request_method",
                "http_route"
            )
        )
     / 
        sum by (operation) (
            label_join(
                rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_deployment_environment_name), ', service_namespace=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_namespace), ', service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), ']),
                "operation",
                " ",
                "http_request_method",
                "http_route"
            )
        )
    ) or (0 * 
        sum by (operation) (
            label_join(
                rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_deployment_environment_name), ', service_namespace=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_namespace), ', service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), ']),
                "operation",
                " ",
                "http_request_method",
                "http_route"
            )
        )
    )'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'))

WITH if(has([${deployment_environment_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${deployment_environment_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_deployment_environment_name,
if(has([${service_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service_name,
if(has([${service_namespace:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_namespace:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service_namespace
SELECT timestamp AS time, if(isFinite(value), value, NULL) AS "Duration",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQuery(demo_metrics, concat('histogram_quantile(
            0.99,
            sum by (le, operation) (
                label_join(
                rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{deployment_environment_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_deployment_environment_name), ', service_namespace=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_namespace), ', service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '}[5m]),
                "operation",
                " ",
                "http_request_method",
                "http_route"
                )
            )
        )'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'))

display.name: Logs
display.description:
Logs of the service, filtered by `service.name`, `service.namespace`, and `deployment.environment.name`.

To explore the logs, open the menu clicking on the icon `⋮` of this panel and click on `Explore`.

spec.query: SELECT Timestamp, Body, SeverityText, ServiceName, TraceId, SpanId, ResourceAttributes, LogAttributes, EventName FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AND match(ServiceName, concat('^(?:', if(has([${service_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_name:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$')) AND match(ResourceAttributes['service.namespace'], concat('^(?:', if(has([${service_namespace:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_namespace:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$')) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: Traces
display.description: Traces containing a span emitted by the service

spec.query:
SELECT * FROM otel_traces WHERE TraceId IN (
  SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AND match(ServiceName, concat('^(?:', if(has([${service_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_name:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$')) AND match(ResourceAttributes['service.namespace'], concat('^(?:', if(has([${service_namespace:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_namespace:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$'))
  GROUP BY TraceId ORDER BY max(Timestamp) DESC LIMIT 50
) ORDER BY Timestamp
